quakeDiagnostic.title: Detect QUAKE device connection
quakeDiagnostic.subtitle: Both USB and HDMI must be connected properly before entering device settings

check.passDetails: Connection is stable, no action needed

steps.1: Make sure you're using a USB cable that supports data transfer
steps.2: Connect QUAKE directly to a computer USB port and temporarily remove the USB Hub
steps.3: Try a different USB port on your computer and reconnect QUAKE

hdmi.label: HDMI monitor connection

steps.1: Check the connection status of the Mini HDMI port on the left side of QUAKE
steps.2: Try a different HDMI port or HDMI adapter on your computer
steps.3: Confirm the second display is recognized in system display settings and resolution is 1920x480

hdmi.failResolution: Display detected, but resolution is incorrect (current {width}x{height}, expected 1920x480)

resolutionSteps.1: Open your system display settings and select the QUAKE screen
resolutionSteps.3: If 1920x480 is not listed, reconnect the QUAKE HDMI cable and re-detect

toast.allPass: Detection complete, both connections are normal
toast.checkError: Detection error, please try again later

quakeDiagnostic.supportNotReady: Support link coming soon, please try again later

displayMode.farRight: Move Quake to the far right
displayMode.placementDetail: open-quake will use Quake as a separate display and place it to the far right of your other screens. If Quake is your main display, another screen will become the main display. Your other screens will keep their positions relative to each other. You can change this arrangement later in System Settings > Displays.

displayMode.title: 显示模式
displayMode.detail: Quake 当前为镜像模式，需改为扩展显示才能正常使用。拒绝将断开设备连接。
displayMode.orientationTitle: 请调整 Quake 屏幕方向
displayMode.orientationMessage: 请将 Quake 设为横屏
displayMode.orientationDetail: 打开系统显示设置，将 Quake 调整为横屏后返回。
displayMode.orientationDetailDarwin: 打开「系统设置 → 显示器」，将 Quake 的旋转设为 270°。
displayMode.orientationDetailWin32: 打开「设置 → 系统 → 显示」，将 Quake 的显示方向设为「横向」。
displayMode.laterDetail: 稍后处理会保持设备连接，并在 10 分钟后再次提醒。
displayMode.farRight: 将 Quake 移至最右侧
displayMode.placementDetail: open-quake 会将 Quake 用作独立显示器，并放在其他屏幕的最右侧。如果 Quake 是主显示器，其他屏幕将成为主显示器。其余屏幕的相对位置保持不变。你可以稍后在系统设置 > 显示器中更改排列。
displayMode.windowsExtendDetail: open-quake 会将 Windows 切换为扩展模式，以便将 Quake 用作独立显示器。稍后处理会保持设备连接。
